name: Text embedding to generator parameters
description: Embed title/description (Transformers.js MiniLM, ~384 dims), project to a few numbers (hue, shape id, density) to drive a deterministic generator.

restrictions: Depends on the embedding model licence (all-MiniLM-L6-v2: Apache-2.0)
license.notes: Model files ~23 MB quantised; first-run download; vectors can differ across runtimes/quantisation, so cache the derived params per item.

verdictReason: Gives similar items similar colours and shapes with no per-call cost; the model download is the hurdle.
